argv: sha256sum /out/prepare_host_network /out/host_network && /out/host_network && for case in version help print-config; do echo CLI_${case}_BEGIN; if [ "$case" = print-config ]; then /out/prepare_host_network --disable-ipv6 --no-container-mode --container-runtime-endpoint=unix:///tmp/external-runtime/containerd.sock --print-config 2>&1 || exit 1; else /out/prepare_host_network --$case 2>&1 || exit 1; fi; echo CLI_${case}_END; done
